name: 17458-gsm8kbatch-llada2mini-1gpu
model: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini. NOT SUBSTITUTABLE: the engine's diffusion path accepts only this architecture family and raises on anything else. Ungated, ~32.5 GB in bf16 over 7 safetensors shards.
parallelism: tp1 on one card. EP=1, PP=1, no router, no external cache tier, no disaggregation.
architecture: LLaDA2MoeModelLM, a diffusion language model: 20 layers, hidden 2048, 16 query over 4 KV heads at head_dim 128, 256 routed experts top-8 plus 1 shared, ~16 B total / ~1.4 B active, vocab 157184, bf16, no quantization. Full detail is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, bounded at 200 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed 42, first 10% of the run discarded as warmup.
workload: Five-shot GSM8K, shipped with the item as configs/data/gsm8k-5shot-200.jsonl: 200 rows, one turn each, raw text to /v1/completions with no chat template. Prompt 866 tokens mean, sd 24, min 829, max 939, including an 800-token five-shot preamble common to every row. temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, three stop strings; output length is not pinned and typically lands near ~120 tokens.
purpose: A grade-school math solver handling 200 five-shot word problems, 32 at a time, on one GPU.
launch:
# One H100 serving a diffusion language model, answering five-shot grade-school arithmetic.

# THE MODEL IS NOT INTERCHANGEABLE: this engine's diffusion path recognises exactly this
# architecture family and raises on anything else.
model-path: inclusionAI/LLaDA2.0-mini

# The checkpoint carries its own modelling code. Required to load it at all.
trust-remote-code: true

max-running-requests: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.9
attention-backend: flashinfer
dllm-algorithm: LowConfidence
